17.description: The Saskatoon Environmental Advisory Committee will write a letter supporting Wild About Saskatoon's request for $1,000 to fund its annual pollinator celebration. The committee also plans an information booth at the event.

chips.text: Funding will be provided after the event, upon submission of a report on spending.
The initiative has 174 registered gardens across 54 Saskatoon neighborhoods.
